from pathlib import Path
import bpy,json,hashlib
out=Path(r'D:\Dev\vibeGamingDemo1\ThreeHearthsVillage\Art\WoodProductionKit')
with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(out/'WoodProductionKit.blend'),link=False) as (src,dst):
    report={'source_blend':'WoodProductionKit.blend','objects':sorted(src.objects),'meshes':sorted(src.meshes),'materials':sorted(src.materials),'armatures':list(src.armatures),'actions':list(src.actions)}
assert len(report['objects'])==4 and len(report['meshes'])==2
assert not report['armatures'] and not report['actions']
assert all(name.startswith('wip_log_to_') for name in report['objects'])
assert all(name.startswith('WP_') for name in report['materials'])
report.update({'new_original_intermediates_only':True,'existing_assets_copied_into_source':False,'source_blend_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'WoodProductionKit.blend').read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(out/'source-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('WOOD_SOURCE_AUDIT_PASSED')
